summary: David says that wicked tongues devise mischief and the wicked trust in riches—The Saints trust in the mercy of God forever.
meta_description: David says that wicked tongues devise mischief and the wicked trust in riches—The Saints trust in the mercy of God forever.
section_headings: To the chief Musician, Maschil, A Psalm of David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech.
